# GitHub Actions workflows

This directory contains the CI/CD pipelines for `cs2-analyser`. Workflows use pinned major action versions and never echo secret values.

## Index

| Workflow | File | Trigger | Runner | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ci` | `ci.yml` | `pull_request` to `dev`/`staging`/`main`, and `push` to `dev` | `ubuntu-latest` | Fast PR feedback: TypeScript typecheck + Vite build, Rust `cargo check` + clippy (warnings as errors), and Python syntax check on the analyzer sources. Three jobs run in parallel. |
| `release` | `release.yml` | `push` of any tag matching `v*`, plus `workflow_dispatch` with a `tag` input | `windows-latest` | Builds the Python analyzer as a PyInstaller single-file sidecar, builds the signed Tauri MSI + NSIS bundles, generates the `latest.json` updater manifest, and publishes everything as a GitHub Release. |

## Required GitHub Actions secrets

Only the `release` workflow needs secrets. CI runs entirely on public inputs.

| Secret | Used by | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` | `release.yml` | Tauri updater private key. Paste the full contents of the `.tauri/cs2-analyser.key` file generated by `pnpm tauri signer generate`. Treat as a sensitive credential; rotation procedure is in `docs/SECURITY.md`. |
| `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD` | `release.yml` | Passphrase that protects the private key. In v0.1 the key was generated without a password, so this secret may be set to an empty string. It must still exist so the workflow's `env:` block resolves cleanly. |

See `docs/SECURITY.md` for the full secret-handling policy and how to add a secret in the GitHub UI.

## Branch policy reminder

`main` is for tagged releases only. Tags `v*` pushed to `main` trigger `release.yml`. All other code lands on `dev` first, gets promoted to `staging`, then to `main` via PRs. The `ci.yml` workflow gates every PR.
